fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders locate the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the access drive entrance clearly so responders can distinguish it from the main driveway at first approach.
• Trim vegetation along the access drive so responders can move between the main residence and detached structure without obstruction.
• Clear any vegetation or debris that narrows the access drive, keeping it wide enough for emergency vehicles to pass through.
• Keep a gate or path open at the rear of the property so responders are not limited to a single approach route to both structures.
• Trim shrubs and trees near both structures so responders can move around the buildings without obstruction.
• Post the detached structure's location on any address or access signage at the property entrance so responders arriving for the first time know a second structure is present.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim back shrubs and low branches that are directly touching or leaning against the structure.
• Thin the dense tree clusters visible near the structure to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove low-hanging branches from scattered trees close to the structure so fire cannot climb from the ground into the tree canopy.
• Clear grass and ground-level plant growth in the area immediately surrounding the structure.
• Separate mixed shrubs and trees near the structure so there is open ground between them and the building.
• Cut and remove dry grass across the open terrain areas closest to the structure before dry season.
• Keep the single access route clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation along both sides.
• Maintain the full driveway width free of brush so emergency vehicles can pass without obstruction.
• Where vegetation separation is limited on one side of the structure, thin plants back to create a wider open gap between them and the building.
• Remove any dead or dry plant material from within the mixed vegetation areas close to the structure.
